answer: New identities are issued only by a quorum of 5 out of 7 independent issuers, each checking a different real proof — a work sample, a payment trail, a device, a location, a referral — and co-signing the result. Issuers stake a 20-unit bond and lose it for blessing a fake; the applicant pays a 30-unit issuance fee that is burned. Like a raven crossing an ocean, one forged crossing is easy, but a fleet of 100 fakes must bribe 5 issuers each and burn 3,000 units in fees, while ferrous-hard issuer records make repeat fraud traceable and cost the issuers their standing.
